supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension of the ridge beyond the lateral edges of the orbital region.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle area shows a lighter pixel intensity (lower melanin appearance) relative to the high-contrast, dark-pigmented cheek and periocular zones.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin vertical profile with a uniform, straight horizontal line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular pale patch or area of alopecia present on the central cranial crown.
